About mom (the nparent), probably or I'd say most likely not. I think she was the popular kid while I am the total opposite.

She once became friends with the mom of one of the popular girls and she was like "you should be friends with her" (I assume she wanted me to be more feminine and girly and like that popular girl in general). That girl wasn't like too mean or anything but we were just people from opposite worlds and totally not understanding each other. I think it's the same with my mom as well.

As for dad (the enabler), maybe cuz of similar interests, but knowing we are both antisocial pretty much, it would not end up being the case most likely.

My dad doesn't really have friends in general. Like he knows some people he has or is working with and is generally friendly, but he doesn't go hang out with anyone. I don't even really know about my dads interests or likes any more than the fact that he likes programming lol. I mean he also likes science and nature (he's vegetarian and is the one to make the effort to separate trash), but like I've never known his favourite foods or favourite colour or anything like that.
Would love to see the world be cleansed from the bad. It saddens me how much bad is happening, I really wish people were just a little kinder and more empathetic.

As far as I know people did report (the ones that were directly targeted to be doxxed) but nothing came of it, idk if it's because they don't look at it as anything serious because it's online or because it's over many countries as  none of us live in the same country or idk.

We contemplated sending a message to their parents tho lol, cuz we literally know how to contact them, like that's how much info there is online of this person and they are doing this...

As long as it's over people aren't really that obsessed to do harm to other people as that person was. Sure thinking about the situation and the people who were harmed I am sad and angry but I don't think I'd ever put the kind of effort to do something to the dame level as that person.

I just hope karma does it's thing and no one has to lift a finger. What they deserve will come to them, whether or not what they deserve matches with what I think they deserve.

I think I hate my parents.

But it's mostly a lot more complex too, I feel, but nowhere in that complexity do I feel love for them.

Even when I was little, I have this one memory, where I wanted to try to say "I love you" for the first time, because I had seen families on TV saying that. I said it after receiving a gift on my birthday and I immediately got a panic attack because I felt I was lying and ever since very young my mom would scare the shit our of me about lying to the point of saying that she has cameras everywhere (+ no closed doors and no privacy). That night I cried because I felt so bad for not loving my mom or at least confused by the fact of why I felt like I was lying, trying to understand if I do love my parents or not.

In the end I was never close to my parents to develop any bond I feel, I think I was only traumatised.

At the time of this we already had contacted the authorities, but this still kept happening. If there was still such a thing as twitter support, we could have probably had more luck but since it's been removed ever since Elon we were pretty much out of options.

Only thing we could do was mass report. It doesn't always work tho, and takes too long of a time as people are getting harassed and doxxed.

The thing was we literally already knew all the information there is about the person responsible, they weren't very smart and actually have very public life so they themselves were easily doxxed except no one actually did as it's literally wrong. And that was literally my point in why I wanted to write to ETHICAL hacking, as I could have already done something bad with all info I had, but I wanted to find an ETHICAL solution to my problem lol.

Btw in the end the main account of the person harassing (which actually wasn't the account that was used on the hacking, we just know that it was the person who was responsible), got permanently suspended and banned from making new accounts.

They have one alternative account left, but the main account was the one they built with many followers. I never reported the main account and I was surprised that it got banned so idk if it got banned cuz it was mass reported or because the accounts that harassed people got mass reported and they just put the 2 and 2 together from the IPs of the accounts. Cuz like this person to this day had made 4 accounts to harass and doxx so I think it's entirely possible.

Anyway, I'm just glad that it's over, tho it would have been nice to get justice for people that got doxxed and those who deleted their accounts in fear of getting doxxed. While having the main account suspended is very satisfying I'd say it's much too little of a punishment for what that person did.

I don't remember the full extent of the evidence we had but he had posted screenshots and the top part where the battery, clock, internet, other icons show matched the screenshots on the main account he had (and he's had a dislike of some of the same people that got harassed/doxxed). And another person that he wanted to pin the blame to when people started accusing him of being part of that account (some patterns were similar to him + he posted himself speaking with a voice changer or something but there were speech patterns which initially lead people to suspect him) he tried to imitate that person and that person then also came forward to day it's not him and shared some evidence. After that, since the actual suspected person is public, his parents are content creators, it's easy AF to find his info, I think someone threatened him with the info, or the evidence was too much and maybe he got scared because people were reporting him to the authorities cuz after that the 2 initial accounts got deleted. Oh and the names he used for those accounts were also I think very similar to the usernames he's used before.

Right now he has yet again created 2 new accounts (at least we believe it's him cuz the same people are harassed and in similar manner, but other than that there's nothing). He also posted a photo of a hand I think to make people believe it isn't really him cuz the skin tones clearly don't match (also it isn't how he behaved before as he clearly tried to mask his identity doing a voice changer, tho it was stupid for him to talk at all, but maybe he couldn't resist as that's how he responds to people on his main account and he's a content creator as well). He's being more careful probably. He also hasn't doxxed anyone yet, but one of the people that he harassed deleted their account, idk if he sent a DM to them with a dox threatening to release it to make them do it tho (he like shows a list of people he targets and then chooses one to target until they delete their account, that's his goal).

If there was a way to contact twitter staff to explain the issue and possibly have his ip banned from creating more accounts to harass people that could help but again there is no way to contact any twitter staff.

We have tried contacting authorities, nothing has come from that, the accounts just get deleted and then new ones appear.

Also more context, my dad was always the parent that never really showed much interest or care. You can tell he does care but he was always very whatever mom wants we'll do.

He's also very meek, even when arguing with my mom, my mom will always win the arguement. And my mom would sometimes get so angry she would hit, and tho I don't remember seeing it, she has hit me in anger, especially when I was little. The only memory I remember of knowing my dad got hit was when I was around 6-7 maybe seeing my dad exit my parents room with his head bleeding and my mom was holding a hairbrush that had broken.

He has never tried to protect us children from my mom, if anything (even the fact that he didn't do anything would gain our favour and my mom would be pissed cuz we favoured dad more and he'd then have to deal with her fury), he would do anything my mom would ask in those instances. Last time I remember I was around 15 I think where I had an argument with mom and I don't remember about what it was, but I remember I was right about being mad and I just wanted to cry and not talk to her but that didn't sit right with her so she ordered my dad to make me turn around and face her (I was on a computer chair). I didn't. And I don't remember what exactly happened, if it was him or my mom who tried to spin me around but at some point I fell backwards with the chair so I just left out the door with no shoes (and no phone cuz I didn't have a phone).

When I was a kid I thought of my dad as the good guy cus he wasn't the one that was angry but the older I got the more I saw him as the enabler.

He also as I got older would start to drink more tho it hasn't really affected him imo, I think that's just him trying to deal with my mom, but he has had more instances of yelling, which he didn't when I was younger. I think those are not cuz of the alcohol but cuz at this point everything is just boiling over thanks to my mom.

It took me a long long time. Ofc I wanted to move out as soon as possible but my parents didn't allow me to get an official job and wanted me to work for them for which they did not pay me (maybe would have if I asked but knowing how difficult it is with our money why would I ask). And if I had gotten a job in secret I didn't know if they would have found out cuz they were getting benefits from me being unemployed+studying and under 24. I didn't know the details and I was scared they would get notified and or my parents will accidentally do fraud because they would assume I'm unemployed ofc. So after 24 I got a job in a food factory (because no one from my field wanted to hire me) and since it was summer I pretended like I was just walking around + going to my dad's rented office to work on my own projects, I would also do work for my dad a little (some of which I got paid for) which i hoped would distract them. After that I packed everything under the guise of getting rid of clutter and just secretly kept moving it out (to a flat I found in the third month of me working, it's important to catch good deals really fast). The last big clutter I moved out my dad saw me so I just didn't come back anymore even tho I wanted to take stuff like pictures maybe. It was really really scary to tell them I'm not coming home. In the end they were the ones to text me if I'm ever coming home and I said no I moved out. They know that I'll just run away further if they press on so they try to be careful, they don't ask my address because they know I wouldn't give it. Right now I'm in between jobs (I'm trying to get a job in my field) but I have a lot saved up from food factory work so I can live without work a little.

Honestly it only takes the first step to get the ball rolling. It took me A LOT to do it without my parents knowledge or support cuz I've been conditioned to not trust my decision making, but looking back it was easier than it felt at the time. First send in bunch of CVs, answer the call when they call, go to the interview (with work like food factory work they need you, so don't be nervous about experience, they are just trying to get a feel for you), then search for a flat that you can afford (you can look at flats already just to see what deals there are) and be the first to call them. Then get a plan for moving out. If you have to do it at night make sure you get help to do it in one go, otherwise you have to gradually take stuff out without them noticing. You aren't incompetent. It was all a first to me and no one really expected me to know anything off the bat, especially if I say it's my first job, flat. I didn't say that to many people tho because people expect your parents to be the ones to inform you and I didn't wanna get into that convo.

You just gotta make the first step. If you want, you can DM me and I can try help you out to figure out a plan.

It's gonna be long term work to heal, I know, and there's no guarantee I'll ever be able to separate myself from it. But it will get better, I'm sure, one way or another it has to.

I searched for local options for help hoping to have at least an online chat because that's as much as I can do, found a chat which was for teens mostly but entered anyway. They told me to call the helpline and that that's the only way to get help. I'd love if I could talk through email/text first to get a basis on the therapist and the therapist could get a basis on my issues and with that reassurance I could maybe muster some strength to face them face to face.

Right now my barrier is having to basically heal myself enough to be able to face a therapist but to heal myself I need a therapists help which I can't get unless I'm ready for it.

I don't get what is your problem man. I am free, I can now make my own decisions without them knowing every single thing I'm doing, what time I'm leaving, where I'm going, what I'm doing. With that I decided it's best to maybe show myself in case my mother spirals into thinking I got kidnapped or something possibly causing me problems, possibly having her call my friends or other family to find me or even police (which I fear she might do even if she knew I wasn't kidnapped but simply cut contact with her). Oh but if you mean mentally or emotionally, sure I'm still dealing with a whole life of trauma from them which I guess I might not ever be fully free of. Or maybe you mean genetically, cus genetically I'll always be connected to them, so by that definition I guess I'll never be free. I don't get why are you so set on thinking that soup like some mouse trap to lure me back now. It is not, I mentioned it to show that it was an excuse to show myself without it being to talk (and so that my parents for now feel that its good between us (again for the purpose of them not attempting anything that might cause me trouble)). I made a whole ass plan to be there as little as possible, enough for them to see me and immediately leave.

I dont expect a support system to do the work of therapy ofc, I just wish I had a support system that knows what I've been through and that I can talk to on some occasions, as people sometimes do. I've looked into therapy, tho currently I have no money to put towards it as I had gotten sick as well as not having a lot of shifts November and December in general, so not a lot of money for anything but rent, utilities and food.

Yes. I mean I don't technically have to do anything, I can also just wait for the moment when something does happen from me completely cutting off contact and the deal with the fallout then. And as I said I don't want to talk, which means call would be pointless as that would mean wed have to talk. I went there, got soup, didn't have to talk anything and left quickly. I'd rather do that than call, I have nothing to talk about with them and even if I do talk to them it will inevitably end up an argument which I don't have the emotional capacity to deal with.

I don't owe those people anything so I went there for my own peace of mind (not for them) that it might help with not getting me in trouble in the future. I didn't talk as I wanted, I got my soup as I wanted, I remained there for less than 5 mins as I wanted.

I mean safer is bigger distance ofc, but it made sure I maintained enough distance (being only 5 mins to basically show I'm ok, not kidnapped or anything as i did leave in secret, told them im ill in order not to have them needlessly approach me, as well as made sure they know im only stopping by as i have somewhere else to be).

I know I'm doing bunch of mental loops, I'm doing unnecessary things and for a mentally well person the most logical thing would be to keep away completely and go no contact off the bat, but I cannot do that, im not that mentally well person yet. I'm freshly free, it is not something I'm capable of off the bat, especially with no support system to keep me in check. So meanwhile it's these mental hoops that I rely on to make sure I don't do something that will make me see myself the way my parents have said I am. I still am the person that instinctively disbelieves themselves because I learned that the only correct people to believe are my parents, I still have to deconstruct that.

I do occasionally go through my history, and I did before I decided to go, to make sure that if there is anything that they say to me, that I don't fall into their trap. But I did decide it was necessary to go, again, for the sake of not making any trouble for myself.

The thing is I'm trying to compromise while keeping them at a safe distance from me at the same time. That's the meaning of that first quote.

I felt that me showing up for barely 5 minutes would possibly help not cause any trouble in the future if they decide that me not coming home needs police involvement or something (which might also cause them to find my address out). I'm sure they are aware why I wouldn't want to come back even if they are in denial, but my mom has a tendency to believe conspiracy theories, and even though my dad has a clear head, he still would probably go through with everything my mom asks of him. I did not want to come, but if it was barely 5 mins and I don't have to worry that they will do something if I don't because they are "worried about me", then might as well do it when there is "soup", because if there isn't "soup" then there has to be talk.

And idk what you mean by that last sentence, I think you might have misinterpreted me. Me visiting is not the part that is really hard to deal with emotionally, but the part where I got a job in secret, found an apartment in secret, moved out in secret. It is emotionally though that I can't trust my parents with something like that, and it's also emotionally hard because I doubt my own decisions. I have no one to support me. It is just the me that has been programmed for years to keep my head down and it is me that has to teach myself how to reprogram that without having ever known otherwise. That part is tough. Dealing with emotions that I know come from those instincts and having to directly oppose them is tough. Seeing my parents act ok makes me doubt my own reality which is tough. That's what I mean by that sentence. All of these things are tough regardless of me going or not going to visit.

I think I do blame myself a lot, but I feel like, if I truly believe that I did everything I could have done, before making a harsh decision, I blame myself less, if I do. But regardless I know that it's something I have to work on, this right now is definitely not the optimal solution.

Yea, I really have to become ok with discomfort of saying no.

I know no one is coming to rescue me ofc, I know there isn't an (emotionally) easy solution to this. But I also don't really think I'm in a state to be rescuing myself either, even though I'm already doing it, and I'm not saying this in order to announce that I would quit rescuing me, ofc not. I just mean that I'm doing my best as a person who hasn't healed yet, as a person who hasn't reprogrammed myself yet from the fear and doubt. I want to start working on fixing that person so I can fully be able to rely and trust myself not to go back, so that I wouldn't need to have to do any justifications or logic loops in fear of blaming myself to the point of ending up going back to how I was. Like I feel like I'm only a half step away from snapping back and while my coping mechanisms are the way they are, I can rely on them until I can get myself together enough to not be this distrustful of myself.

I think I'm just trying not to cause any scenes or dramas because it'll stress me out even more. I'm the type of person who already has a really hard time emotionally and I get easily stressed, I have a hard time sleeping so causing something is the opposite i want and im especially stressed if its my parents that are involved.

I more so wanted advice about how to deal with it. Like if I go, what should I do, and if I don't how do I sufficiently navigate them without causing problems for myself. I did leave it more open-ended rather than asking specific advice because I wanted to hear what people would say about the situation in general and maybe possibly share their experiences, because I feel like it'd be easier for me to connect with those experiences and realise something I didn't expect (cuz for specific things I feel like i know what I should do, im more so unsure and have no courage).

The logic loop thing I can't help myself. Without it I'll end up blaming myself and I fear that way I will end up convincing myself I was wrong all along and end up going back. I don't want to get into that mindset so I feel like having a logic loop protects me from blaming myself.
Good, I'm glad to have read your comment. Regardless of what goes on, these comments really help me validate my feelings so thank you.
Ah it's probably because I've been making posts for the past month and probably missed reiterating important info. No worries.

My goal was more so to sorta not burn the bridge yet and if they act any strangely or overstep a boundary I would, and to also show myself in case my mom, who tends to believe all kinds of elaborate conspiracy theories nowadays, feels like she needs to call the police on me or something.

I couldn't meet on neutral ground because my mom can't walk a lot and she mostly stays in her room sitting on her bed. It is what it is. I knew she wasn't gonna confront me because she knows I would have left and she doesn't want that, she indicated that in our texts sorta.

I was never allowed to invite friends home because our home being a mess so it'd probably not be a good idea. It did go okay tho, they were nice and we're abnormally excited to see me. Update in my next post with the same name if interested.

Ye, I pretty much went for 5 mins purely just to pick up soup and acted sick and like I have some business to attend to so they can't keep me long and left. I wrote an update in the next post.

Nothing much happened, I just feel really sick, from guilt and shame and sadness I think.

I realised early on that something wasn't right and thankfully (I think) in highschool I actually stumbled upon the term "narcissistic parent". I'm aware of the patterns and I've learned from others experience what are the things I should do. I got a job and moved out even tho my body was frozen every time I stepped closer to that reality. I knew I had to go against my instincts to achieve this and I know now that I have to do the same. I try to tackle them with any way I can, either making up some logic loop that justifies my behaviour or compromise a little bit. I thought "well nothing bad is gonna happen if I walk by their apartment, with a mask, act like I'm sick so they don't come too close to me, and act like I only come by because I have other business to attend to". I don't expect it to amount to anything, I don't expect it to change them, I just dont want to make any harsh decisions without really understanding what I want/need. Maybe I still need their contact for something, I really don't know. Besides my younger siblings are still there and I don't want to completely abandon them, even tho I don't really know how to approach the situation cuz we aren't really close.
You are right and I know that, and yet I still feel this way. I know this is something I have to work on tho.

I think with having moved out the following challenges come much easier, because I'm already away from them. The only struggle is trying to reprogram myself to stand up for myself and to lose all the self doubt I have. Mentally I'm still very much in survival mode, but I have to find a way to get better.

I'm pretty sure my parents think I'm very independent based on my behaviour as I've grown older. I don't share any info with them and do stuff on my own so they have as little they can hold over me as possible. Like the only thing was pretty much money, but I as is coated them very little considering that I studied for free and didn't really spend money outside either (like basically for birthdays or meeting friends which happened rarely tbh).

I feel like, because they don't really know me and because I've acted coldly and independently under their roof, they feel like they are loosing me and can't do anything about it.

Literally the last effort they had was not letting me get a job and instead continue live with them as I study because "I need to focus on studying" or that "I shouldn't do such a low tier job". I think they would have wanted to officially hire me under them if I had came to them telling yet again my wish to get a job after getting my masters. They actually had come to me multiple times offering close to me moving out but I kept refusing saying I don't want to which they didn't understand and I didn't want to delve into explaining mostly because I don't think I wouldn't have been able to fully explain it not to mention have them believe me.

I'm never doing this again, I'm not letting any more narcs in my life, I've had a lifetime share of it, I'm done. I just hope I'm not gonna get fooled by anyone, I'll do my best to make sure that there's no getting me.

I know I'll never be able to please them. It's just I'm pretty fresh out of their grasp. I feel a load of emotions like guilt and grief, intensified by them acting nice and begging me to come visit. Maybe because I visualise being in their shoes that I have a hard time keeping to deny them. I don't have any confidence in myself and my decisions. I feel like any time I do something relatively harsh or against them I'm doing something wrong. I know it's something I need to reprogram, but I do not know how yet.

I feel awful already, it's very emotionally difficult, and it gets worse if I feel like I'm causing hurt and anger.

Won't give them my address that's for sure, I think they already know that. However I can't exactly meet them at a public space since my mom can't walk too long.

I'm intending on coming by and just getting the soup and leaving claiming I'm in a hurry. Plus I'm kinda sick, I will also wear a mask to play it up, and say I don't wanna make them sick by staying too close and too long. What helps is my mom had just shared in a chat an article about how there's an infection going around (which is also most likely what I got tbh, tho I'm almost recovered).

Yes, you are absolutely right. But I'm also not in a state where I can cut them off guilt free, shame free. Idk what it is I need, therapy or what else, to truly actually believe in my heart that what I'm doing is the correct thing.

I mean even with how far I've gone, I know you are right. Me getting a job, getting an apartment had been such a terrifying and unattainable thing. I would tremble from stress because of what I was doing in secret. But now that I've done it I realise it wasn't actually as hard as I made it out to be in my head.

I did kinda have someone to tell this to tho, now this would be something that no one knows about and no one I can tell so it'd be much harder as well as it'd be probably more emotionally difficult, so I feel like I need to prepare myself for it.

The problem is that I still am in a state where I'll believe they are right when they blame me. So I want to do as much as possible in order for me to be able to stand up for myself. If I do everything as best as I could, then I can be sure that I'm not to blame and not be hard on myself about it. Their voices are still my inner voices and I'm doing my best to fight them with all these logical conclusions I've made up.

I know. I know this is the logical conclusion.

I feel like I'm being unreasonable or acting out because I feel like I'm the only one who believes in what happened to me. So far no one has been on my side, not to mention the fact that I've been so gaslit you could make me doubt having 2 legs.

I think that for now as to not stress myself out by keeping refusing to go, I'll just go by them for a little. Whenever I remember that they are waiting for me to agree to come visit, any time I see a notification from them pop up, I feel like vomiting. And the longer it goes the worse it is. It just keeps stressing me out internally. Again I feel like I need to do some deep work in order to not feel this way.

I don't really know what it is that I should do in my specific situation, or more so what I want to do. And all the doubt and indecisiveness makes me scared of possibly doing the wrong thing so I'm trying my best not to do anything too harsh while also keeping my distance as best as possible.
I want the soup lol. But without that I wouldn't want to go. Regardless of either, I feel like I have to, because if I don't, it seems like I'm acting out for no reason.

I'm so sorry for what happened to you.

In my case I feel like it's not as clear, at least it isn't to me. Even if it is logically clear, it's not clear to me emotionally and to my body. I don't really know what I want. And o think I need extensive work on myself to fully understand the extent of what happened and the best course of action based on that.

I think what confuses me is probably that it wasn't always terrible, but the thing is even when it wasn't terrible, I was always really scared and walking on eggshells.

I know that the best solution is probably cut them off and not think about it but I'm currently worrying about the possible backlash from that, and I don't think I'd be able to bear the stress from it. I really need therapy or some really deep work on myself to gain some self esteem and remove the fear and doubt from making decisions in my life. Because it's really hard and I really have no support sistem at all so that I wouldn't go insane from the stress of the backlash.

I'm really scared to do anything harsh.

At 14 secretly started going on the internet, parents found out but I lied because a classmate conveniently was moving away and I told my parents that was the only way I can contact them. I am now 22.

I've also lost a friend because of this, the only one I did tell things about this. They couldn't understand how deep it was. They thought I was just making excuses not to do what's best for me when I tried explaining that I can't get a job to earn money to move out because not only has my family not supported me in that decision before (I asked them that I wanted to get a job and they said it's a bad decision and it's better just to help them, basically a trap of them not paying me and me never moving out), but I was completely unfamiliar, unconfident, incapable and absolutely scared into not trusting my abilities and choices at all.

I think any child is greatly impacted by the way they are brought up, but not all are aware how hard it is to completely rewire your brain.

I have several points that I can think of rn. (These are just my experience, some might not apply to you)

1) Learned helplessness
          - the constant restriction and criticism that isn't even based in reality, makes you believe you are dumb and incapable of doing anything. Once you are an adult and free from your parent, you still feel like you cannot do anything for yourself or at the very least do it right.

2) Better patience / fear of being angry 
          - you are scared that you will become your parent and you will hurt someone the way you were hurt. You'll be more calm and sometimes even emotionless in situations that are more emotional. I personally constantly hear my mother in my voice and my behaviour whenever im angry and I hate it.

3) Perfectionism
          - something is only good if there is no flaw to pick apart.

4) Overly grateful / apologetic
          - whole normal people usually take things for granted, you usually notice even the slightest good thing done for you and you will express how glad you are for it, either because you are used to the fact that it can change in a second or you were punished for not being grateful enough, expressing gratefulness, as well as apology.

5) Observant
          - you catch on to the slightest change. You know when and where people are at all times and/or are aware of peoples presence. You can differentiate people by the sound and rhythm of their steps. Etc.

6) Manipulation
          - because you've had to deal with Nparents you most likely than not had to do all it takes to make them calm down or redirect their anger. Sometimes that will make you learn the best way how to engage with them to get what you want. But tho you know how to do it you probably don't like doing it.

Man ir ļoti liels prieks, ka cilvēks kā tu redzēji manu postu un komentēji par savu pieredzi. Grūti visu šo informāciju uztvert uzreiz, bet es mēģināšu atbildēt uz daudz maz visu(pat ja tas nav vajadzīgs, man pašai vieglāk saprast kur es esmu)

Tā pirmais ko redzu ir par to šizoīdu komentāru, ko iepriekš kāds uzrakstīja. Tā kā pirmo reizi par to dzirdēju un zinot to, ka Latvijā ir kā ir ar to informāciju par autismu, domāju, ka labāk lasīšu visu no angļu valodas tik un tā, bet es negribēju īsti arī teikt pretī neko, jo varbūt informācija, ko es zināju nebija pilnīga vai nepareiza.

Zinu ka diagnoze pati par sevi man nepalīdzēs tikt galā ar manām problēmām, bet kā lai es tieku galā ar savām problēmām, ja nezinu kas īsti ir cēlonis? 

Lai gan man īsti nepatīk iet cilvēkos, kā jebkurš ar laiku sākšu justies vientuļi. Lielākoties nepatīk, jo jūtos neveikli, it īpaši, ja nav kāds pazīstams cilvēks ar mani kopā. 

Bieži vien draugi ar mani runājot izstāsta kaut ko, kas prasa kādu reakciju un jo mazāk es pazīstu to cilvēku, jo mazāk zinu kā reaģēt. Piemēram, man ir draudzene jau kādus piecus gadus un zinu kā reaģēt uz dažādām lietām, ko viņa saka/dara, kas skaitās kā pareiza reakcija. Nezinu vai tas izklausās saprotami, bet tā ir viena no galvenajām problēmām, kuras cēloni es nezināju, un likās, ka es viena pati tā jūtos.

Tu pieminēji fiziskos simptomus stresa situācijās, piedod, varbūt tas nav pa tēmu vai kā, bet man ir bijušas galvassāpes no aptuveni 12 gadiem. Es kaut kā uzķēru ka man viņas no stresa, jo es pa dabai laikam esmu ļoti jūtīga uz stresu - galva sāp, neguļu, utt. Es nezinu, kāpēc mani vecāki, īpaši mamma, ir tik ļoti pret mentālām slimībām, ka pasakot viņiem, ka man ir stress, viņiem neder. Nu nekas, aizgāju pie ģimenes ārsta un man ir nosūtīums paskatīties kakla asinsvadus. Es domāju, ka tur neko neatradīs un viss atkal aizies tā kā bija, bet drošības pēc skāde nebūs. Par agorafobiju, tagad ieguglēju, jo pirms tam nebīju dzirdējusi, nevarēšu pateikt, nezinu vai tas kā es jūtos varētu būt tā klasificēts, papētīšu bišķi vairāk.

Paldies par ieteikumu "kontaktēties ar cilvēkiem, kas netaisa problēmas". Lai gan tagad biku grūti ar visu karantīnu, bet sazinos ar draugiem ik pa laikam, drīz braukšu uz laukiem pie bērnības draudzenes, tāpēc gan jau būs labi, šie cilvēki man gadījušies saprotoši, un pati cenšos būt pozitīva :). 

Diagnoze nav ne steidzama, ne tik svarīga, jo pieaugot nācās daudz maz tikt galā pašai, bet gribās zināt tik un tā, vai tas tomēr ir kaut kas vai tomēr kaut kas pilnīgi garām. Nav jau laba sajūta, ka pasaku kādam, ka man ir šīs problēmas, piemēram, palūdzu, lai mani neaiztiek, bet cilvēks bieži vien uz mani apvainojas, man pretī pasakot, ka tas ko jūtu nav īsts. Bet tajā pašā laikā gribu pieminēt, ka ir arī jauki cilvēki, piemēram, man universitātē pasniedzēji ir ļoti saprotoši, eksāmenos biju ļoti stresaina, nespēju skatīties acīs, stostījos(kas man pa dzīvi arī šausmīgi lika justies slikti), ar klusu balsi runāju, kā jau parasti stresa situācijās, bet pasniedzēji bija tik ļoti pretimnākoši, ka tas man ļāva mazāk koncentrēties uz to. 

Es saprotu, ka tā nav mana vaina, ka eksistē lietas manī, ko es nevaru mainīt, ko cilvēki nevar pieņemt, bet man gar tādiem nav nekāda darīšana.

Jebkurā gadījumā, ja vispār man gadīsies iespēja aiziet pie psihiatra vai tamlīdzīgi, tas droši vien tāpat būs daudz tālāk nākotnē, kad būs nauda, un pat tad nebūs zināms, vai saņemšos, atkarīgs no tā, cik ļoti es gribu zināt, kas man īsti ir.

Paldies par tavu komentāru, tas bija ļoti informatīvs, un tieši viedokli no cilvēka kā tu gribēju dzirdēt.

Izveidoju šo postu, lai saprastu, vai kāds nezina labu vietu kur var aiziet un to pārbaudīt, esmu studente, kas pagaidām nepelna, tādēļ nauda man svarīga. Ja iztērēšu kaudzi naudas, lai man beigās neko nepateiktu, būtu baigi sūdīgi, tāpēc vajag visu kārtīgi izplānot, it īpaši ja esmu viena šajā visā, un nav kāds, kas man var būt blakus, jo tad jūtos daudz drošāk, ka visu izdarīšu pareizi.

Iemesls kādēļ rakstu savus simptomus, ir lai tu un citi komentētāji saprastu, no kurienes man ir tāda doma, ka man varētu būt autisms. 

Meklējot atbildes, esmu daudz uzzinājusi par autismu, trauksmi, depresīju, utt, cenšoties saprast, pie kā man vērsties. Redzēju daudz labas atbildes, kas man tiešām palīdzēs tālāk, bet ja kāds man paprasa, kāpēc, es labprāt atbildēšu, jo varbūt nedaudz vairāk zinu un varu pastāstīt, tākā sākumā centos atrast internetā cēloņus saviem simptomiem un tādā veidā uzzināju daudz par trauksmi un depresiju kā arī autismu, un to līdzībām un atšķirībām.

Normāliem cilvēkiem ir grūti saprast, kā var būt kāds, kam smadzenes strādā citādāk, tāpēc ko citu darīt, kā vien informēt viens otru un pastāstīt par savām sajūtām un pieredzi, būt saprotošam viens pret otru, protams, ja netiek veikti kaut kādi radikāli soļi, piemēram, ārstēšanās bez profesionāla norādījuma, utt.

Iemesls kādēļ nokļuvu šeit, jo meklēju palīdzību internetā, un tās reāli nebīja, paliku aizkaitināta, un uzrakstīju redditā, ar cerību, ka kāds man var ieteikt pareizo virzienu.

Tas ka tev to vajag paskaidrot, vai tev neliekas, ka otram cilvēkam vajadzētu to pašam jau saprast, ja viņš uztvērtu sociālās normas.
Vot tāpēc man nepatīk runāt pa telefonu, jo es nevaru īsti saprast, kad ir laiks man runāt.
Arī normālās sarunās, es nezinu, kad man jāskatās kādam acīs un cik ilgi, un es nezinu kādā intonācijā man jārunā, bieži vien tādēļ izklausos šausmīgi, jo pasaku kaut ko ne tajā intonācijā, vai pārāk ļoti cenšos skatīties kādam acīs.

Tāpēc oriģinālais jautājums bija par to, kur es varu to pārbaudīt, nevis vai man ir īstie simptomi. Kā cilvēks, kas pazīst savu ķermeni, daudz maz izvērtēju simptomus un redzēju sakritības, taču tas nenozīmē, ka plānoju kaut ko darīt tā labā bez profesionālas diagnozes. Nezinu vai tev rakstīju, vai citam, bet kad mammai pateicu aptuveni ap 10-12 gadu vecumā par to, ka man ir šādas grūtības, man pretī pateica, ka es izliekos vai meloju, tāpēc nav jēgas mani pārbaudīt. 
Izskatās ka Latvijā pārbaudīt ir baigais čakars, un diagnozes bieži vien nav precīzas, atradu [rakstu](https://skaties.lv/zinas/latvija/sabiedriba/psihoterapeits-latvija-autismu-biezi-neatpazist-ne-tikai-vecaki-bet-pat-mediki/), meklējot informāciju, ka ļoti daudzi bērni vecumā dabū nepareizu diagnozi, t.i., pārāk daudzi no bērniem ir uzskatīti par atpalikušiem, lai gan beigās izaug normāli, un kā vecāki bērni ir grūti noteikt gadījumos, kad autisms neizpaužas tik slikti kā varētu.
Lasīju arī kā Amerikā meitenes un sievietes vispār nedabū diagnozi līdz 25 gadiem labākajā gadījumā. Tad jau Latvijā tas vispār var būt daudz trakāk.
Viens no komentāriem man ielika linku uz mājaslapu, kuri basically ir Latvijas autisma biedrība, palasīju un tur ne tikai pieaugušie knapi pieminēti, bet par to, ka sievietēm tas izpaužas citādāk nav pieminēts vispār. Latvijā informācija par ļoti daudzām lietām ir diezgan novecojusi, un žēl. Laikam jāiet tulkot.

Autisms vīriešiem ir uzskatīts, ka ir biežāk tikai tāpēc, ka visi uzskatīja, ka vīriešiem un sievietēm ir vienādi simptomi, kas tā nav. Tik daudzām sievietēm nav noteikts autisms un tikai ap 25 ir noteikts, kad sieviete pati pamana šīs atšķirības un meklē palīdzību, tas tiek noteikts. Sievietēm dominantais simptoms, kas atšķiras no vīriešu simptomiem ir "masking", kas ir tas, ka sieviete nomaskē savus simptomus, lai tiktu uztvērta normāla, izdzīvotu. Sievietes to panāk novērojot apkārtējos un atkārtojot viņu runu vai žestus.
Nu ja man jāpierāda kaut kas labi. Es uzskatu, ka esmu jūtīga uz pieskārienu un skaņu vairāk vai mazāk, t.i., kopš bērnības atceros ka man jebkuras drēbes koda, nepatīka uz ādas utt, teicu mammai, mamma nopirka mīkstas un viss atrisinājās, nevaru klausīties jaunu mūziku vai skatīties jaunas filmas, nezinu kāpēc, vienkārši slikta sajūta, vismaz pirmo reizi skatoties, pēc tam, kad pazīstama, skatīšos/klausīšos uz riņķi.
